postconditions.description: The output list f must have exactly n-1 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= 10**6 for f_i in f)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list f must be an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(passenger_answer_consistent(a_j, b_j, g_j, f) for a_j, b_j, g_j in passenger_questions)
postconditions.description: For each passenger's question, the output list f must make the answer to the question consistent with the given minimum scenery beauty.

postconditions.expression: not any(passenger_answer_inconsistent(a_j, b_j, g_j, f) for a_j, b_j, g_j in passenger_questions)
postconditions.description: There must not be any passenger's question for which the answer is inconsistent with the given output list f.

invariants.description: The number of railway stations n is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
The number of passenger questions m is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a_j, b_j <= n and a_j != b_j and 1 <= g_j <= 10**6 for a_j, b_j, g_j in passenger_questions)
invariants.description: Each passenger's question has valid departure and arrival stations (between 1 and n inclusive) and a valid minimum scenery beauty (between 1 and 10^6 inclusive).
